plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was one of us. That's the whole of it, and it's a great deal.
There's a place at the table that will stay empty a while. We'll leave it so.
I keep thinking of something I meant to say to {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll say it now, and hope it carries.
[longtime] {YEARS} years with us. There's hardly a wall or a field here {OTHER_nameDef} didn't put a hand to.
[longtime] {OTHER_nameDef} saw this place through its raids and its lean seasons, and never once talked of leaving.
[longtime] {OTHER_nameDef} was here before many of us. Some of what we know of this place, we learned from {OTHER_objective}.
[titled] {TITLE}, we called {OTHER_objective}, and not one of us had to think twice about why.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} meant to {GOAL}. It's not finished, and it's not forgotten.
[battle] {FACTION} came for us, and {OTHER_nameDef} is the price we paid. We won't forget what they took.
[kin] I knew {OTHER_nameDef} before any of you did. I'll miss {OTHER_objective} longer than any of you will.
[partner] Half of every plan I've made had {OTHER_nameDef} in it. I don't know yet what to do with the other half.
[rival] {OTHER_nameDef} never let me get away with anything. I'll have to watch myself now.
[stranger] I didn't know {OTHER_nameDef} well. Somebody should say something, so I will.
[deadchild] {OTHER_nameDef} had all of it ahead. We'll carry what we can of it.
[deadold] {OTHER_nameDef} lived a long life, much of it before any of us knew {OTHER_objective}. I wish we'd asked more about it.
[tribal] We'll keep {OTHER_nameDef}'s name in the stories at the fire. That's how the people remember.
[medieval] We'll say {OTHER_nameDef}'s name at the feasts, so the young ones know whose work they're living in.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was kind to me when I needed it. I'll pass it on. That's the only way I know to thank {OTHER_objective} now.
[longtime] {YEARS} years of {OTHER_nameDef}. We were lucky, every one of us.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s gone. We're less without {OTHER_objective}. That's it.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would want us to eat well tonight and tell stories. So let's do that.
[longtime] {YEARS} years, and {OTHER_nameDef} never once let a day go dull. I'll try to keep that up.

gloomy.li: Another grave. Every one of them takes a piece of the rest of us with it.
[deadold] {OTHER_nameDef} had a long life. It still wasn't enough.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. The colony is smaller and the work is harder. We'll manage, because we must.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} meant to {GOAL} and didn't get to. Someone should take it up.
